help.stock: Stock details are optional. Add a stock name, supplier, received date, or stock expenses only when you need a fuller purchasing record.
help.products: Think of products as Group → Variety → Item. Example: iPhone 15 Pro Max → Natural Titanium · 256 GB → each phone's IMEI. Start with the group, then record the exact variety you received.
help.catalog: A product group keeps the same main product together. Each variety is one exact sellable configuration inside that group, and individual items can carry their own identifiers.
help.record: Enter how many units you received and the buying price per unit. For individually tracked stock, add each item's IMEI, serial number, or other identifier.
help.review: Check the products you recorded, then save a draft or finish and receive the stock. Optional stock details are included only when you entered them.
help.familyAssignment: A product group keeps related versions of the same product together. Example: iPhone 15 Pro Max is the group; Natural Titanium · 256 GB and Blue Titanium · 512 GB are varieties inside it.
help.autoSku: Describe the details that define this exact variety, such as Color + Storage, Screen size, Size + Color, or RAM + Storage. Tunakuza handles the SKU automatically.
help.existingSku: A variety is one exact version inside a product group. Choose an existing variety if it is already there, or add a new one.
help.existingCategory: Choose a product group, then choose an existing variety or add a new one inside it.
help.newCategory: A product group is the main product people recognize, for example iPhone 15 Pro Max. After creating the group, add its first variety.
help.uncategorized: Use a simple product when you do not need a product group. You can still record it by quantity or track each item separately.

fieldHelp.productGroup: The main product all its varieties belong to. Example: iSense TV.
fieldHelp.variety: One exact sellable version of this product.
fieldHelp.varietyDetails: Add the details that make this variety different from others in the same group. Keep the same detail types across the group when possible. Examples: Color + Storage, Screen size, Size + Color, RAM + Storage, or Pack size.
fieldHelp.tracking: Choose Quantity when you only need to know how many you have. Choose Individual items when each physical unit needs its own IMEI, serial number, barcode, or other identifier.
fieldHelp.quantity: How many units of this variety you received in this stock.
fieldHelp.buyingPrice: What you paid for one unit. Buying price does not change which variety the product belongs to.
fieldHelp.identifier: The unique number for this physical item, such as an IMEI, serial number, chassis number, or barcode.
fieldHelp.simpleProduct: Use this only for a product you do not need to organize into a product group.

trackingHelp.individual: Each unit has its own identifier

products.noGroups: No product groups yet. Create your first group to start recording stock.
products.noVarieties: No varieties yet. Add the first version of this product.
products.noMatchingGroups: No matching product groups or products found.
products.chooseOrAddVariety: Choose a variety or add a new one
products.addingVariety: Adding a new variety to this group

validation.catalogRequired: Add at least one product to this stock.
validation.conversionPositive: Enter a conversion greater than zero.
validation.familyName: Enter the new product group name.
validation.varietyDetails: Complete each variety detail and do not repeat the same detail type.
validation.identifier: Enter the identifier for this item.
